title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: goodwill waiver authority, quota and request window by document type
content:
## Scope

The documentation desk may waive documentation fees as goodwill within limits set per Bills of Lading and Transport Documents type. This table gives, for every type, the largest single fee row the desk may waive, the number of goodwill documentation waivers per customer in any trailing 365 days, and the calendar days after a fee was booked within which a goodwill waiver may be requested.

## Tier table

| Document type | Largest single fee row the desk may waive | Goodwill waivers per customer per trailing 365 days | Request window after the fee was booked (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | USD 50.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | USD 50.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | USD 75.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | USD 75.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | USD 100.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | USD 0.00 | 0 | 15 |

## Reading the table

- The authority is a limit per fee row, in USD.
- The AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading has the widest limits: USD 100.00 per row, 2 waivers per trailing 365 days and a 45-day request window.

## Derived point on the AHL Switch Bill of Lading

The quota on the AHL Switch Bill of Lading is 0. Because a customer's goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days must be fewer than the quota, and no count can be fewer than 0, no goodwill waiver can satisfy the quota on that type.

## Points of judgement

**What is the largest fee row the desk may waive on an AHL Straight Bill of Lading?** USD 75.00.

**Within how many days of the fee being booked must a waiver be requested on an AHL Electronic Bill of Lading?** 30 calendar days.
